chunks: And from al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah who said:

I was seated with the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) when a man came to him and said: 'By Allah, I love you (for the sake of Allah).' He replied: 'You have spoken the truth, for our essence is a treasure that Allah took a pledge of from the loins of Adam. Therefore, clothe yourself with poverty, for I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saying: By Allah, O Ali, poverty comes faster to those who love you than a flood to the bottom of a valley.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.طِينَتُنَا: Our essence/substance (referring to the spiritual origin of the Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of poverty in relation to the lovers of Imam Ali according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah narrates that a man expressed his love for Imam Ali (a.s.), to which the Imam responded by affirming the man's sincerity and highlighting the divine origin of the Prophet's and Imams' essence. He then advised the man to embrace poverty, citing a saying of the Prophet that poverty is a natural companion to those who love Ali.
